comment: DRAFT E0, 2026-11-20; final thresholds require the lead's acceptance. One main ce253e336 shared-stream day, seed 73107, against the archived seed 73106 control; see reports/engine/2026-11-14-npc-data/e0-tolerance.md. Completeness gates are copied from 6c: both runs done and full length, zero unmatched samples and missing final NPCs; these are validity requirements with no allowance. min_activity_same_mob=0.99985: measured 28896/28898=0.999930791058 (2 mismatches); allows at most 4 mismatches at this sample count (fractional budget 4.3347), twice the observed noise, with 0.000080791058 share headroom (0.0080791 percentage points). min_activity_same_wp=0.99: measured 93326/93925=0.993622571200; 0.003622571200 share headroom (0.3622571 percentage points), allowing 939.25 rather than 599 mismatches. MOB time ratio measured 28997/28898=1.003425842619; bounds 0.99..1.01 give symmetric 1% allowance around equality, almost three times the observed 0.3425843% drift; measured lower/upper headroom 0.013425842619/0.006574157381. max_activity_arrival_p95=5: measured 0 game minutes, plus one journal step of 5 minutes. max_activity_arrival_max=5: measured 0 game minutes, plus one journal step of 5 minutes; the maximum is signed B minus A over all selected routine segments. max_activity_stuck=0: measured 0 unique NPCs, no allowance; every NPC missing all MOB samples in a reference segment must fail. These two bounds follow the lead review decision of 2026-11-20. Same-seed strict and 6c profiles are unchanged. Pooled p95 alone misses an isolated late arrival; the maximum rejects the 15- and 30-minute mutations without --activity-states. The 15-minute mutation loses only 3 MOB samples and passes the same-MOB bound; the missing-object mutation also fails max_activity_stuck.
